title: SSC MTS 2023 Tier-1 Art & Culture PART-2

questions.question: According to the Hindu calendar, Holi is celebrated on _____________.
Yakshagana is a folk dance that belongs to the state of __________________.
For which dance form did Vasundhara Doraswamy get Sangeet Natak Akademi Award (Akademi Puraskar) for the year 2019?
The cultural heritage of Siddhis from _________ dates back to almost 300 years and their Siddhi Dhamal dance is an exquisite art form.
Which of the dance was immediately preceded by a practice session called sevakali and undertaken in the precincts of a temple?
Who among the following was the director of Kathak Kendra and also opened his own dance school named ‘Kalashram’?
____________ has two traditions: one is the sankeertana (which is the devotional aspect) and the other is the raasa.
The ‘Ka Shad Mastieh’ or victory dance of the____________ tribe of Meghalaya is an ancient war dance performed during the prominent festival of the tribe.
Which dance form is associated with Natwari Dance?
_____________ literally means 'dance of the enchantress'. It is one of the most striking in the Indian classical dance repertoire.
Dandari (Dancing) troupes perform __________ during the festival of Diwali for a fortnight with participation from Kolam and Raj Gond tribes.
Bihu is a folk dance of which state?
The celebrated folk artist Gulabo Sapera, recipient of Padma Shri Award in 2016, is an exponent of _____________ dance.
Gaur Maria, a dance form from the state of ____________, is a well-known art form of joy and invocation. It is a group dance and both, males and females enthusiastically participate in this dance.
The national award of classical dance is called ___________.
The Paika dance of Jharkhand is usually performed by the ___________ tribe to welcome special respected guests or during the religious procession (Shobha Yatra).
The ‘Mukteshwar’ dance festival is held from 14th to 16th January at the Mukteshwar temple in the state of ___________.
Identify the WRONG pair of dancer and the related dance form from the following.
Lebang Boomani dance is the harvest dance of ____________.
Mahari Dance and Gotipua Dance belongs to which of the following states?

The Songi Mukhawate dance of ___________ celebrates the victory of truth over falsehood. The name of the dance is derived from the two lion masks worn by two dancers who represent Narasimha, an aspect of Lord Vishnu.
Who among the following is best known for creating a fusion style of dance by adapting European theatrical techniques to Indian classical dance?
Who among the following dancers is associated with Indian classical dance form of Kathak?
Rikham pada dance belongs to which of the following states?
Chhau, identified by the Ministry of Culture as a classical dance, is prevalent in eastern India and has three distinct forms. Which of the following is NOT one of them?
